tagline: Calm black-and-white essays: your voice-over becomes one glowing metaphor that morphs scene to scene, with small quiet captions. A seated-on-camera version is included.
readiness_note: Morph chains are checked by eye until the continuity validator ships; lit objects (towers, globes, spheres) render as engine 3D objects, one at a time.
